description: Ollama self-hosted LLM starter — Docker Compose + thin TS client. Local-first, llama.cpp-backed, GGUF models. Port 11434, OpenAI-compatible /api/generate + /api/chat.

commands: docker compose exec ollama ollama pull llama3.2

buildHints.whenToUse: Self-hosted / local LLM inference where privacy, offline operation, or zero-vendor-cost matter more than absolute throughput. Pick over vllm-server when targeting laptops, edge, or air-gapped deploys; pick vllm-server for production GPU serving at scale.
firstSteps: Start the server: `docker compose up -d` — binds 11434 on host. CPU-only by default; uncomment the GPU block in docker-compose.yml to use CUDA.
Pull a model (one-time): `docker compose exec ollama ollama pull llama3.2` (or qwen2.5, mistral, gemma3 — see https://ollama.com/library). First pull is ~2-8 GB.
Install client deps: `pnpm install`. The TS client in `src/client.ts` calls `POST /api/generate` and streams JSON lines.
Customize the model: edit `Modelfile` (FROM llama3.2, SYSTEM prompt, PARAMETER temperature ...), then `ollama create <name> -f Modelfile` inside the container.
Verify: `curl http://localhost:11434/api/tags` lists loaded models. `pnpm dev` runs the example client call.
gotchas: Models are pulled at runtime, NOT baked into the image. A fresh container has zero models — the first request on an unpulled model returns a clear error, not a hang.
The Ollama streaming response is newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON), NOT SSE. Parse line-by-line with a decoder that handles partial lines across chunks — naive JSON.parse on chunks will corrupt.
`ollama run <model>` is an interactive REPL inside the container — do NOT use it from scripts. Use the HTTP API for programmatic calls.
GPU inference requires `deploy.resources.reservations.devices` in docker-compose.yml AND nvidia-container-toolkit on the host. Missing either silently falls back to CPU (slow).
architectureNotes: Ollama wraps llama.cpp — inference runs in a single process; parallelism is limited. For multi-tenant high-QPS, put a queue in front or move to vllm-server.
Model storage lives in the `ollama` named volume — survive container recreation, but a volume `docker volume rm` deletes everything. Back up before upgrades.
